name: inspect_web_network_capture
description: Inspect retained local HAR 1.2 or native mitmproxy capture records without contacting recorded URLs. Returns original ordinals, pointers/byte ranges, preserved producer fields, precise numeric representations and exact exposed binary bytes inline. Excludes known transport credentials and explicitly marked values. Decodes every record before optional ordinal selection; malformed or oversized captures return no partial success. Duplicate HAR members are invalid; prototype-named members such as __proto__ are preserved as ordinary own JSON members without prototype mutation. Uses pinned upstream parsers, owned temporary files and bounded offline processes. Native mitmproxy requires caller-supplied mitmdump 12.2.3 on Linux. Browser transaction IDs, runtime attribution and original bytes of HAR Unicode text remain unknown.

__schema0.description: Absolute local HAR or mitmproxy capture path.

__schema2.description: Zero-based producer record ordinals, in caller-selected order. Omit to inspect every record.

__schema5.description: Literal text excluded from capture payloads, byte/numeric projections, producer coordinates, artifact paths/digests and diagnostic text. Declaration strings are never persisted in Evidence parameters. Canonical contract keys, enums and provider identities remain intact.

capture_path.description: Absolute local HAR or mitmproxy capture path.
